translation: They found the design plans for the old palace building that had been destroyed by fire, making it possible to rebuild it.

korean: 남에게 존경받는 사람이 되려면 어떻게 해야 할까?

For a high jumper to leap.

To not work out at all.
Did you hear that the thief who targeted only rich houses was caught?

To get out of the car along the way.

korean: 승규는 몰던 차를 멈추고 가까운 기차역에 도중하차해 목적지를 바꾸기로 결정했다.

To drop out of a competition.
For anger to flare up again.

translation: This plane will soon arrive at its destination, Incheon.

translation: The new governor held an inauguration ceremony and began his term by handling official business at the provincial government building.

korean: 이 사진은 명암이 도치되어서 일상 장면을 색다르게 보이게 하는 효과를 주고 있어요.
translation: In this photo, light and dark are inverted, giving the effect of making an everyday scene look different.

korean: 그 문장은 주어와 서술어를 도치해 주어가 서술어 뒤에 나온다.
translation: That sentence inverts the subject and predicate, so the subject comes after the predicate.
to be weeded out from the market

korean: 우리 집 뒷산에는 참나무가 많은데 가을이 되면 도토리가 많이 열려.
translation: There are many oak trees in the mountain behind our house, and many acorns grow there in the autumn.

korean: 그 녀석은 도통 기본이 안 된 녀석이야.
translation: That guy lacks the basic fundamentals completely.

korean: 그 사람 아직 젊은 것 같던데 그 큰돈을 어떻게 벌었대?

korean: 네가 시험을 앞두고 그러는 건 도피에 지나지 않아. 시험은 어김없이 찾아온다고.
translation: Doing that right before an exam is nothing more than an escape. The exam is coming no matter what.

korean: 이 건물의 삼 층에는 좌우에 다섯 개씩 도합 열 개의 강의실이 있다.
translation: On the third floor of this building, there are five lecture rooms on the left and five on the right, making a total of ten.

korean: 오늘 회의에 참석하는 사람이 몇 명이죠?
translation: How many people are attending today's meeting?

korean: 길쭉한 사각형의 종이의 한쪽을 백팔십 도 돌려 양 끝을 붙이면 안도 없고 바깥도 없는 신기한 도형이 된다.
translation: If you twist one end of a long rectangular piece of paper 180 degrees and attach both ends, it becomes a fascinating figure with no inside or outside.

korean: 엄마, 내일 미술 시간에 도화지를 가져오래요.
translation: Mom, they told us to bring drawing paper for art class tomorrow.

korean: 지수는 외모에서 차갑고 빈틈없는 도회적 이미지를 풍긴다.
translation: Jisu projects a cool, meticulous, and urbane image through her appearance.
Welfare for elderly people living alone.

korean: 우리 동아리에서는 연말을 맞아 독거노인을 찾아 위로하고, 마음을 나누는 봉사 활동을 계획하였다.
translation: To mark the end of the year, our club planned volunteer activities to visit, comfort, and connect with elderly people living alone.

korean: 어제 한 공장의 보일러가 폭발하면서 독극물이 유출되는 사고가 있었다.
translation: Yesterday, a factory boiler exploded, causing an accident where toxic substances leaked.

korean: 중대장은 부대를 자신만의 판단에 따라 독단적으로 운영하려 했다.
translation: The company commander tried to operate the unit arbitrarily based solely on his own judgment.

korean: 요새 언론이 한쪽으로만 치우쳐서 보도를 하고 있는 것 같아.
translation: It seems like the media is reporting with a bias lately.

korean: 제이 차 세계 대전 이후 대부분의 식민지들이 독립되었다.
translation: After World War II, most colonies became independent.

korean: 나와 남편은 아이들을 독립시켜 자기 인생을 스스로 선택하고 책임지게 했다.
translation: My husband and I made our children independent so they could choose their own lives and take responsibility for them.

korean: 부모는 자녀들이 부모에 의존하지 않고 스스로 살아갈 수 있도록 독립심을 길러 줘야 한다.
translation: Parents should foster a spirit of independence in their children so that they can live on their own without relying on their parents.

To take up a poisoned cup.

korean: 증오나 분노의 감정을 직접적으로 나타낼 수 없을 때 독백으로 표현하는 사람들이 많다.
translation: Many people express their feelings through a monologue when they cannot directly show hatred or anger.

korean: 민준이의 할아버지는 풀숲에 앉아 계시다 독뱀에 물려 돌아가시고 말았다.
translation: Minjun's grandfather was sitting in the thicket when he was bitten by a venomous snake and passed away.

korean: 천재적인 작곡가가 이렇게 젊은 나이에 생을 마감하다니 안타깝네요.
translation: It is tragic that such a genius composer ended his life at such a young age.
Why is Seunggyu so unusually lost in his reading?
To go to a study room regularly.

korean: 집 근처에 새로 생긴 독서실은 책상도 넓고 쾌적해서 공부가 잘된다.
translation: The study room that newly opened near my house has wide desks and is pleasant, so it's easy to study there.

korean: 카페에는 혼자 앉아서 커피를 마시며 독서하는 사람들이 많았다.
translation: In the cafe, there were many people sitting alone, drinking coffee and reading.

korean: 지수는 독선에 사로잡혀 남의 말은 받아들이지 않고 모든 일을 자기 혼자 독단으로 결정했다.
translation: Jisu was overcome with self-righteousness, refusing to accept others' words and deciding everything arbitrarily on her own.
To shower someone with biting remarks.

korean: 지수가 승규한테 약속을 어겼다고 독설을 퍼붓는 것 봤어?
translation: Did you see Jisu pouring biting remarks on Seunggyu for breaking his promise?
Wow, it's a mushroom! Shall we pick it and eat it?

korean: 이 학원의 원장은 오십 대 후반의 독신녀이다.
translation: The director of this academy is a single woman in her late fifties.

korean: 지수는 나이도 많은데 결혼도 안 하는 걸 보니 독신주의인가?
translation: Ji-soo is getting older and isn't getting married; I wonder if she is committed to staying single.

korean: 지나친 음주는 사람에게 치명적인 독약이 된다.
translation: Excessive drinking becomes a deadly poison to a person.

korean: 지수는 독일 교포로 오해를 받은 일도 있을 만큼 독어를 유창하게 구사한다.
translation: Jisu speaks German so fluently that she has even been mistaken for a Korean raised in Germany.
To grow up as an only son.

korean: 승규는 독자로 외롭게 자라서 형제가 있는 친구들을 부러워했다.
translation: Seunggyu grew up lonely as an only son, so he envied friends who had siblings.
To submit a piece to the reader's column.

korean: 그는 모든 면에서 자신만의 음악 세계를 독자적으로 구성해 왔다.
translation: He has independently built his own musical world in every aspect.

korean: 김 화백의 그림은 동양화에 서양 회화 기법을 도입한 독자적인 화풍으로 인기를 끌었다.
translation: Painter Kim's paintings gained popularity for their distinctive artistic style, which incorporated Western painting techniques into traditional Asian painting.

korean: 역사적으로 반란을 일으켜 정권을 차지하고 독재를 펼치고자 했던 장군도 있었다.
translation: Historically, there were generals who staged rebellions to seize power and exercise dictatorship.

korean: 혁명 이후에 권력이 한 사람에게 독점되어 장기 독재가 실시되었다.
translation: After the revolution, power was monopolized by one person, leading to a long-term dictatorship.

korean: 1989년 해외여행 자유화로 특권층의 독점물이었던 해외여행을 온 국민이 누릴 수 있게 되었다.
translation: With the liberalization of overseas travel in 1989, all citizens came to enjoy overseas travel, which had been the exclusive privilege of the privileged class.
Empty a glass of hard liquor.

korean: 한글은 자음과 모음이 한눈에 구분되는 글자라는 점에서 다른 문자에서는 유례를 찾을 수 없는 독창성을 지닌다.
translation: Hangeul possesses an unprecedented originality among writing systems in that its consonants and vowels are clearly distinguishable at a glance.

korean: 이 호텔은 기존 호텔 형식을 탈피하여 투숙객이 독채를 사용할 수 있도록 설계되었다.
translation: Breaking away from the traditional hotel format, this hotel is designed so that guests can use a detached building.

korean: 나이가 들수록 결혼을 하라는 부모님의 독촉이 점점 심해지고 있다.
translation: As I get older, my parents' pressure on me to get married is getting worse.

korean: 성형 수술이 대중화되니까 사람들 얼굴이 다 비슷해지는 것 같아.

translation: They took that money and still demanded more money from me, as if it weren't enough.

translation: Manager Kim expected the new product he developed to bring the company a massive fortune.

korean: 저 모서리를 돌면 맛있는 빵을 파는 빵집이 나온다.

korean: 이사 온 기념으로 돌리는 이 떡을 누구에게 드릴 거예요?

translation: To save her husband's company from the risk of bankruptcy, the mother ran around everywhere borrowing money.

translation: We passed around the plate of food and took only as much as we each could eat.

korean: 승규는 민준이와의 싸움을 별일 아닌 것으로 돌리고 아무 일 없었다는 듯이 행동했다.

translation: Shall we play a game to see who can hit the willow tree on the other side of the river?

korean: 세계 정상 회의를 앞두고 테러와 같은 돌발 사태를 대비하기 위해 훈련이 실시되었다.
translation: Ahead of the summit meeting, training was conducted to prepare for unexpected situations such as terrorism.

korean: 세무서 직원으로 속여 집 안에 들어온 이 씨 등은 흉기를 꺼내 들고 강도로 돌변해 금품을 훔쳐 달아났다.
translation: Mr. Lee and his accomplices, who entered the house disguised as tax office employees, whipped out weapons, suddenly turned into robbers, and fled after stealing money and valuables.

korean: 노인은 더듬거리며 나오다가 돌부리에 걸려서 마당에 퍽 엎어졌다.
translation: The old man shuffled out, tripped over a stone, and fell flat on his face in the yard.

korean: 법당 좌측에 모셔진 돌부처는 통일 신라 시대에 만들어진 것으로 오늘날까지 그 모습 그대로 전해지고 있다.
translation: The stone Buddha enshrined on the left side of the main hall was made during the Unified Silla period and has been preserved in that exact state to this day.
To be as rigid and inflexible as a stone Buddha.

korean: 예전에 돌사자를 타고 사진을 찍다가 지나가던 어르신에게 혼이 났던 기억이 있어.
translation: I remember being scolded by an elder passing by when I took a picture riding a stone lion in the past.

korean: 김 사장은 돌산을 깎아 길을 내고 그 옆에 공장을 세웠다.
translation: President Kim cut into the rocky mountain to pave a road and built a factory next to it.
To put on a first-birthday table.

korean: 할머니는 아궁이에 돌솥을 걸고 장작을 피워 된장국을 끓이셨다.
translation: Grandmother hung a stone pot over the hearth, lit firewood, and boiled soybean paste soup.

korean: 오늘부터 한 명씩 돌아가면서 청소를 하자.
translation: Starting today, let's take turns cleaning, one person at a time.

korean: 손댈 수도 없을 만큼 어려운 문제를 보니 눈이 빙글빙글 돌아간다.
translation: Looking at a problem so difficult I can't even touch it, my eyes spin round and round.

korean: 그곳은 눈알이 빙빙 돌아갈 정도로 발 디딜 틈도 없이 사람들이 가득했다.
translation: The place was packed with people so tightly that there was no room to step, making my head spin.

korean: 나는 가끔 대학교 일 학년 때로 돌아가고 싶어.
translation: I sometimes want to go back to my freshman year of college.

korean: 그녀는 장식품이 돌아가지는 않았는지를 확인하며 실내를 꼼꼼히 살폈다.
translation: She carefully inspected the interior, checking whether any ornaments were turned out of position.

translation: With our father's business failing and leaving us penniless, we were left with nowhere to turn.
